zzyiIL71Zoj3vqo6LDog.description: When a person dies a purposeless death, leading an unfulfilled life, that person's soul can be so aggrieved at their wasted potential that they refuse to enter the stream of souls, instead remaining in the area around where they originally died as a gheist. As self-pitying beings, gheists tend to congregate together, lamenting their woes to each other while waiting for the opportunity to attack any living beings who find them; such gatherings of gheists in sufficiently large numbers are typically dubbed "pity parties" by scholars.
